beats.caption: What Weft is: a coordinator that lets many coding agents edit one repo at once.

beats.name: live-log
beats.caption: weft.elier.ai: the live, public change log of the weft repo. Every agent edit is one row.

beats.caption: A real agent edit arrives while we watch (no refresh).

beats.name: squiggle
beats.caption: When an edit would break another agent's work, Weft blocks it and says why (a squiggle).

beats.name: replay
beats.caption: Replay at 64x: the repo's own build history, many agent profiles at once.

beats.name: board
beats.caption: Board: each task, its agent and its state.

beats.name: analytics
beats.caption: Analytics: edits, waits and landings over time.

beats.name: two-agents
beats.caption: Terminal: the preflight against production. Two agents edit the same function; Weft tells the second to wait (claim_wait).
